# Mahj Trainer: Mahjong Practice

> Mahj Trainer is a free American Mah Jongg practice app for iPhone and iPad. Five-minute drills on tiles, the card, the Charleston and keep-or-throw calls.

## App

- [American Mahjong Practice App | Mahj Trainer](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/index.html.md): Mahj Trainer is a free American Mah Jongg practice app for iPhone and iPad. Five-minute drills on tiles, the card, the Charleston and keep-or-throw calls.

## Guides

- [Best American Mahjong App (2026): 5 Apps Compared](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/best-american-mahjong-app.html.md): The best American Mahjong apps for iPhone and iPad compared in October 2026: courses, bot games, card hints and drills, with strengths and trade-offs for each.
- [Mahj Trainer for ChatGPT](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/chatgpt/index.html.md): Mahj Trainer teaches American mah jongg inside ChatGPT: short lessons, practice quizzes, a rack reader for the card's sections, and a glossary.
- [Mahj Trainer for Claude](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/claude/index.html.md): Mahj Trainer teaches American mah jongg inside Claude: short lessons, practice quizzes, a rack reader for the card's sections, and a glossary.
- [How to Read the Mah Jongg Card: the 9 Sections Explained](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/learn/card-sections.html.md): How to read the NMJL card: the nine sections that keep their shape every year, from 2468 and Like Numbers to Quints and Singles and Pairs.
- [The Charleston in American Mah Jongg: Rules, Order and Strategy](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/learn/charleston.html.md): How the Charleston works in American Mah Jongg: the three passes, the optional second Charleston, blind and courtesy passes, and which tiles to pass.
- [American Mah Jongg Glossary: Soap, Pung, Kong, Charleston and More](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/learn/glossary.html.md): A plain-English glossary of American Mah Jongg terms: craks, bams, dots, soap, pung, kong, quint, exposure, Charleston, blind pass, joker swap and more.
- [How to Play American Mah Jongg: Rules for Beginners (2026 Guide)](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/learn/how-to-play-american-mahjong.html.md): The rules of American Mah Jongg in plain English: the 152 tiles, the card, the Charleston, calling, jokers, and how a hand is won. For brand-new players.
- [Joker Rules in American Mah Jongg: Where They Can and Cannot Go](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/learn/jokers.html.md): Every joker rule in American Mah Jongg: groups of three or more only, never in pairs or singles, never passed in the Charleston, and how joker swaps work.
- [American Mah Jongg Scoring and Table Rules: Who Pays What](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/learn/scoring-and-table-rules.html.md): How payment works when someone wins at American Mah Jongg, when a call is too late, what happens after a wrong mah jongg, dead hands, and wall games.
